title: Sparton
summary: Raleigh names Sparton in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Sparton, named with Thebis as parent of the line from which Iolaus drawes the Iewes. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XII, §. IV, sig. 258b–259a
